title: Night Cream for Pimples and Dark Spots: How to Choose and Use One
ex: How to pick a light, non-comedogenic night cream for pimple marks and dark spots, which actives help, and when to see a dermatologist.
rt: Night Cream for Pimples and Dark Spots | Mirc Glow
rd: Night cream for pimples and dark spots: light textures, niacinamide, kojic acid and alpha arbutin, a simple routine, sunscreen tips and when to see a doctor.
keyword: night cream for pimples and dark spots
quick: Choose a light, non-comedogenic night cream with niacinamide, kojic acid or alpha arbutin. Used nightly with SPF 30+ sunscreen every morning, it can help flat pimple marks look less noticeable over about 8–12 weeks. Painful or cystic acne needs a dermatologist first.
facts: Flat marks fade as skin renews, roughly every 4–6 weeks.
Marks often look less noticeable over 8–12 weeks with daily sunscreen.
Oily, breakout-prone skin needs only half a pea-sized amount.
See a dermatologist for painful, deep or cystic acne.
